=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:37,83-140 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:reclarify-requeue` label is in the color catalog and contract but missing from `_AI_LABEL_DESCS`.
  WHY: The contract-parity test fails and label creation falls back to the generic description; five reviewers rate this BLOCKER, while google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rates it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1600 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The queue step's `if` expression references `steps.claude_handoff.outcome`, but the `clarify` job has no step with `id: claude_handoff`.
  WHY: actionlint reports an undefined step ID and fails static checks; z-ai_glm-5_2 instead rates the runtime impact MAJOR, stating the empty outcome makes the condition true and can queue duplicate requests.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py:52,585-611 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `test_idle_poller_replays_only_trusted_failed_reclarify_once` requires `tmp_path`, but the module's direct runner calls discovered tests with no arguments.
  WHY: The direct CI runner raises `TypeError` because the required pytest fixture is not provided.
- tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py:118-128 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `test_pat_budget_steps_bracket_every_active_job` references the deleted `.github/workflows/claude-issue-intake.yml` and the nonexistent `claude-pr-catch-all` job.
  WHY: If run, the test raises `FileNotFoundError` for the deleted workflow and `KeyError` for the nonexistent job; it also does not run from the file's direct-entrypoint block.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1614-1617 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The queue step posts the requeue label before posting the source-marker comment, with no recovery if the comment POST fails.
  WHY: The poller requires a valid source marker to replay the request, so a labeled issue without that marker is skipped and the trusted `/reclarify` request is not replayed.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:396-398 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The sweep skips dispatch when a trusted Claude-fixer hand-off marker matches the current PR head.
  WHY: The Claude-fixer hand-off was retired, so a matching legacy marker can suppress review dispatch without a live session to process the PR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24949-25009,25027-25029 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The standalone clean/noop-clear cache uses the head ref name rather than the fetched head SHA when deciding whether to skip a PR.
  WHY: A same-ref push after the snapshot can make a PR DIRTY while the cached ref name still matches, bypassing the live mergeability check and leaving the DIRTY PR unprocessed for that poll cycle.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:289-343 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `handoff_author` identity probe uses the default PAT instead of `READ_TOKEN`.
  WHY: On each 30-minute sweep with open `claude/*` PRs, the extra `gh api user` call consumes shared PAT budget despite the sweep's otherwise read-token API calls.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:630-651 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The “Replay failed trusted reclarify commands” step runs on every cron tick without checking whether any requeue labels exist.
  WHY: The step makes at least a rate-limit and issue-list API call even when there are no queued issues, consuming shared PAT budget on every 5-minute tick.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py and tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:37 (present in _AI_LABEL_COLORS), absent from 83-140 (_AI_LABEL_DESCS) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new label ai:reclarify-requeue was added to _AI_LABEL_COLORS at line 37 but its description was never added to _AI_LABEL_DESCS at lines 83-140.
  WHY: The contract-parity test at tests/test_ai_labels.py:268 asserts set(helper_descs) == set(contract_labels). Since ai:reclarify-requeue is in the label_contract.v1.json but missing from _AI_LABEL_DESCS, the assert fails. Additionally, ensure_label_exists at line 156 falls back to the generic "AI workflow label" description for any helper-created instance of this label.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1600 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new "Queue failed reclarify for poller" step's if expression references steps.claude_handoff.outcome but no step in the clarify job carries id: claude_handoff. The Claude handoff step was deleted as part of the Claude session retirement in the merge-commit base.
  WHY: Actionlint resolves all steps.* references and raises an error for the undefined step id. The CI static-checks job fails because actionlint cannot validate the workflow.
- tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py:121, 123 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_pat_budget_steps_bracket_every_active_job references the deleted .github/workflows/claude-issue-intake.yml at line 121 and the nonexistent claude-pr-catch-all job in review_autofix_sweep.yml at line 123. Both the workflow file and the job were removed as part of the Claude session retirement in the merge-commit base.
  WHY: yaml.safe_load((REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / file).read_text()) raises FileNotFoundError for the missing workflow, and even if that were fixed, workflow["jobs"]["claude-pr-catch-all"] would raise KeyError since the sweep workflow has only one job (sweep).
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py:52 and 596 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_idle_poller_replays_only_trusted_failed_reclarify_once takes a tmp_path: Path pytest fixture argument, but the module's main() function at line 596 calls every test_* function as func() with zero arguments.
  WHY: The direct runner in main() calls func() without the tmp_path argument, so Python raises TypeError: test_idle_poller_replays_only_trusted_failed_reclarify_once() missing 1 required positional argument: 'tmp_path'. This is confirmed by the CI orchestrate-poll (0) shard log.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1614-1617 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "Queue failed reclarify for poller" step posts the ai:reclarify-requeue label at lines 1614-1615, then posts the source marker comment at lines 1616-1617 as two separate POST calls with no recovery for a marker-comment failure after the label POST succeeded.
  WHY: If the label POST succeeds but the marker-comment POST fails or its response is lost, the poller (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:47-55) requires that marker before replaying. The issue carries an ai:reclarify-requeue label but no valid source marker, so the poller skips it permanently. The trusted /reclarify request is lost without recovery.
TASK_GAP
Requirement: "Add a contract test that the budget log line is emitted by the instrumented jobs."
Expected change site: tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py
Evidence of absence: The test test_pat_budget_steps_bracket_every_active_job verifies workflow YAML step structure (presence of start/end steps) but does not verify that the GH_PAT_BUDGET log line is actually emitted at runtime. No other test in any changed file validates log-line emission. The test is also not wired into the __main__ block (lines 213-217 only call 3 pre-existing tests) and references deleted files (claude-issue-intake.yml) and nonexistent jobs (claude-pr-catch-all), so it would fail even if it ran.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
TASK_GAP
Requirement: "Unit tests for any batching or caching change."
Expected change site: tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py (sweep batching tests) and tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py (poller batching test)
Evidence of absence: Three new sweep tests (test_pat_budget_steps_bracket_every_active_job, test_sweep_batches_only_verified_current_head_handoffs, test_sweep_handoff_skips_only_complete_trusted_same_head, test_reclarify_failure_marker_and_idle_poller_permissions) are not called from the __main__ block (lines 213-217). test_sweep_handoff_skips_only_complete_trusted_same_head also takes tmp_path without fixture support. The poller batching test (test_standalone_snapshot_batches_clean_prs_and_skips_draft_claude_reads) asserts source-text patterns rather than exercising the batched GraphQL response and fallback behavior.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
